note: What a server sends to drive a value of the lasting particle effects on a unit from something that changes. A client ignores it where the id names no unit it knows. The header carries zero.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit: a champion, minion, turret or other unit.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the effects' inputs to drive.

fields.name: point
fields.note: Which point, for source 0. It has no effect unless source is 0.

fields.name: source
fields.note: What drives it. Any other value drives it from nothing.

0.name: capturePoint
0.note: How far the point is taken (CapturePointChanged).

2.name: resourceSmoothed
2.note: The unit's resource bar, smoothed over time.
